Tarte 3 Chocolats Sans Cuisson Ingrédients Base biscuitée • 150 g de biscuits au cacao  • 60 g de beurre fondu Ganache au chocolat blanc • 125 g de crème liquide entière • 240 g de chocolat blanc Ganache au chocolat au lait • 125 g de crème liquide entière • 188 g de chocolat au lait Ganache au chocolat noir • 125 g de crème liquide entière • 105 g de chocolat noir Préparation Préparez la base biscuitée Réduisez les biscuits en poudre fine. Ajoutez le beurre fondu et mélangez jusqu'à obtenir une texture de sable humide. Versez le mélange dans un moule à tarte ou un cercle de 20 cm de diamètre. Tassez fermement le fond ainsi que les bords à l'aide du dos d'une cuillère ou d'un verre. Placez au réfrigérateur pendant 30 minutes. Préparez la ganache au chocolat blanc Hachez finement le chocolat blanc et placez-le dans un saladier. Faites chauffer la crème jusqu'à frémissement, puis versez-la sur le chocolat.  mélangez délicatement du centre vers l'extérieur jusqu'à obtenir une ganache parfaitement lisse. Versez la ganache sur la base biscuitée froide. Placez au réfrigérateur pendant 45 minutes à 1 heure, jusqu'à ce que la surface soit suffisamment ferme pour accueillir la couche suivante. Préparez la ganache au chocolat au lait Hachez le chocolat au lait et déposez-le dans un saladier. Portez la crème à frémissement puis versez-la sur le chocolat. Laissez reposer 1 minute puis mélangez jusqu'à obtenir une texture lisse et brillante. Versez délicatement cette ganache sur la couche de chocolat blanc bien prise.  Placez à nouveau au réfrigérateur pendant 45 minutes à 1 heure. Préparez la ganache au chocolat noir Hachez le chocolat noir et placez-le dans un saladier. Faites chauffer la crème jusqu'à frémissement puis versez-la sur le chocolat.  Versez délicatement sur la couche de chocolat au lait. 🇬🇧 No-Bake Triple Chocolate Tart Ingredients Biscuit Base • 150 g cocoa biscuits • 60 g melted butter White Chocolate Ganache • 125 g heavy cream • 240 g white chocolate Milk Chocolate Ganache • 125 g heavy cream • 188 g milk chocolate Dark Chocolate Ganache • 125 g heavy cream • 105 g dark chocolate Preparation Prepare the Biscuit Base Crush the biscuits into a fine powder. Add the melted butter and mix until you get a texture similar to wet sand. Pour the mixture into a tart pan or a 20 cm pastry ring. Firmly press it onto the base and up the sides using the back of a spoon or a glass. Place in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. Prepare the White Chocolate Ganache Finely chop the white chocolate and place it in a bowl. Heat the cream until it begins to simmer, then pour it over the chocolate. Mix gently from the center outward until the ganache is perfectly smooth. Pour the ganache over the chilled biscuit base. Place in the refrigerator for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until the surface is firm enough to support the next layer. Prepare the Milk Chocolate Ganache Finely chop the milk chocolate and place it in a bowl. Bring the cream to a simmer, then pour it over the chocolate. Let it sit for 1 minute, then stir until smooth and glossy. Carefully pour this ganache over the set white chocolate layer. Return to the refrigerator for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Prepare the Dark Chocolate Ganache Finely chop the dark chocolate and place it in a bowl. Heat the cream until it begins to simmer, then pour it over the chocolate. Carefully pour the ganache over the milk chocolate layer.

Oggi vi do la ricetta del vostro prossimo dolce preferito 😍 solo tre ingredienti e due minuti per questo cremosissimo BUDINO DI BISCOTTI 🍪 una coccola fresca e super golosa che vi farà innamorare 💜 👉🏻 SEGUIMI @cucinafacileconelena per ricevere SEMPRE nuove ricette❣️ 😋 SALVA e CONDIVIDI la RICETTA per non perderla 🤗 Ingredienti: 400 g di latte 200 g di biscotti al cacao 200 g di cioccolato q.b. cacao amaro in polvere (per decorare, opzionale) Procedimento: Scaldate il latte e mettetelo in una ciotola, aggiungete il cioccolato, i biscotti al cacao e, con un frullatore ad immersione, frullate tutto fino ad ottenere un composto abbastanza liquido. Trasferite il composto in ciotoline o bicchieri monoporzione e ponete il budino di biscotti a riposare in frigo per almeno 2 ore, deve rassodarsi un po' e diventare bello cremoso. Potete servirlo con una leggera spolverata di cacao amaro in polvere. 👩🏻‍🍳 La RICETTA completa e dettagliata sul mio blog CUCINA FACILE CON ELENA 🧁🔸blog.giallozafferano.it/cucinafacileconelena/🔸 (link diretto in BIO) 😘 #budino #biscotti #cioccolato #dessert #EasyRecipe

매일 새벽 손으로 직접 만드는 수제만두, 젊은 사장님에게서 느껴지는 '할머니의 손맛' 📍망원 연만두  (주소: 서울 마포구 망원로 77 1층 연만두)   🔗네이버 지도: https://naver.me/5Kb3ejlY   🥟만두 한 판 8,500원 / 왕치즈군만두 1개 2,500원   📦택배 신청: 매주 월요일 오후 5시까지 문자 접수 (연락처: 010-5941- 7816)   망원시장의 소문난 만두 맛집 '연만두'. 많은 분이 연세 지긋한 할머니가 운영하실 거라 오해할 만큼 깊은 손맛을 자랑하는 곳입니다. 하지만 이곳의 주인공은 만두에 인생을 건 젊은 사장님이었는데요.  그 깊은 맛의 비결은 진심어린 정성에 있었습니다.  "기계는 재료를 뭉개버린다"는 철학 아래, 매일 새벽부터 나와 모든 재료를 일일이 손으로 버무리고 직접 빚으시더라구요. 재료 하나하나의 식감이 살아있는 꽉 찬 만두 속은 그렇게 사장님의 고집으로 완성됩니다.  워낙 정성껏 소량만 준비하기 때문에 금세 품절되기로 유명한데요. 방문 전 전화 주문이나 네이버 예약을 이용하시면 헛걸음 없이 바로 가져가실 수 있으니 꼭 참고하세요!   주문 즉시 튀겨주시는 치즈 군만두는 갓 튀겨낸 바삭한 식감 속에 고소하게 늘어나는 치즈와 만두 속의 조화가 그야말로 환상적입니다.. 정성과 맛, 어느 하나 빠지지 않는 망원동의 진정한 인생 만두를 만나보세요!   - Deep flavor hand-mixed every dawn: Finding 'Grandmother's Touch' in a Young Master 📍망원 연만두 'Yeon-Mandu' (77, Mangwon-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea)   🔗 https://maps.app.goo.gl/jDhS1Q11mVTn1mBA9   'Yeon-Mandu' is a renowned dumpling spot near Mangwon Market, famous for a deep, traditional flavor that leads many to assume an elderly grandmother must be running the shop. Surprisingly, the true master behind these dumplings is a young man who has dedicated his life to this craft.   The secret to such profound flavor lies in his sincere devotion. Following his philosophy that "machines crush the ingredients' texture," he starts his day in the early hours of the dawn, hand-mixing and folding every single dumpling. This stubborn commitment is what creates the perfect filling, where the texture of each ingredient remains intact and vibrant.   Because each dumpling is made with such meticulous care in limited quantities, they are famous for selling out quickly. We highly recommend placing a phone order or using Naver Reservation before your visit to ensure you don't miss out!  Don't miss the Cheese Fried Dumplings, fried to order for a perfectly crispy texture. The harmony of the savory, melting cheese and the rich dumpling filling is simply heavenly. Come and experience a true "life-changing" dumpling in Mangwon-dong, where passion and tradition meet! 🥟 #서울맛집 #망원동 #koreanfood #seoul #streetfood

Ooey-Gooey Scoopable Nutella Cookie Pie🤤 Yields: 15-16 Chunky Cookies INGREDIENTS:  230g Cold Chopped Unsalted Butter  160g Caster Sugar  160g Light Brown Sugar  450g Chocolate Chunks or chips  475g Plain Flour  1 tsp Salt 3 tsp Baking Powder  3/4 tsp Baking Soda  2 Eggs  1 Egg Yolk  1 tsp Vanilla  INSTRUCTIONS: •Cut cling wrap into small squares. Scoop ½ teaspoon Nutella onto individual cling-wrap squares. Fold to seal and freeze until solid. (Repeat for however many Nutella stuffed cookies you plan to make.) •In a large mixing bowl, add the cold cubed butter and whisk until slightly creamy. Add the white sugar and light brown sugar, then whisk together until well combined and fluffy. •Add the eggs, vanilla extract, and chocolate chips or chunks. Whisk until fully incorporated. •Add the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Gently mix until just combined, do not overmix. •Portion the dough into 90g balls. Press a frozen Nutella piece into the centre of each dough ball, seal well, and roll into a smooth ball. •Place the stuffed cookie dough balls onto a tray and freeze for at least 30 minutes (or overnight for best results). •Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F). •Take any shape baking dish circle, square, rectangle anything and line it with parchment paper. Arrange frozen cookie dough balls in it leaving some space between them. •Bake for 10-15 minutes (timing depends on the type of pan) or until the tops are lightly golden while the centres remain soft and gooey. •Remove from the oven and let cool slightly. •Serve warm with ice cream and chocolate sauce enjoy!✨ NOTE: Store any extra dough balls in an airtight container or freezer bag and freeze for later. Classic chocolate chip cookies 🤤 Yields: 15-16 Cookies INGREDIENTS:  230g Cold Chopped Unsalted Butter  160g Caster Sugar  160g Light Brown Sugar  450g Chocolate Chunks or chips  475g Plain Flour  1 tsp Salt 3 tsp Baking Powder  3/4 tsp Baking Soda  2 Eggs  1 Egg Yolk  1 tsp Vanilla  INSTRUCTIONS: •In a large mixing bowl, add the cold cubed butter and whisk until slightly creamy. Add the white sugar and light brown sugar, then whisk together until well combined and fluffy. •Add the eggs, vanilla extract, and chocolate chips or chunks. Whisk until fully incorporated. •Add the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Gently mix until just combined, do not overmix. •Portion the dough into 75-80g balls. •Place the cookie dough balls onto a tray and freeze for at least 30 minutes (or overnight for best results). •Preheat oven to 165-170C. Bake for 10-15 minutes or until the tops are lightly golden while the centres remain soft. •Remove from the oven and let cool slightly. •Serve warm with ice cream. NOTE: Store any extra dough balls in an airtight container or freezer bag and freeze for later. Dumbbell Sumo Squat  Know the difference  1. Dumbbell Position Hold the dumbbell with both hands naturally hanging between your legs, rather than holding it at your chest. This allows you to lift heavier weights without being limited by arm strength. 2. Torso Posture Maintain a slight forward lean instead of staying fully upright. Leaning forward increases hip flexion, helping to stretch and better activate the glutes. 3. Stance Width and Foot Angle Set your feet about 1.5 times shoulder-width apart, with your toes pointing outward at roughly a 45-degree angle. If the stance is too wide, the inner thigh muscles (adductors) will take over, reducing glute activation. 4. Load Path As you squat down, the dumbbell should not stay directly under your shoulders. Instead, it should fall slightly behind the midline, closer to your posterior chain. Bring your hands slightly inward to keep the load closer to your center of mass, which helps reduce lower back strain and improves movement efficiency. #gymtips #quads #gluteworkout #gym #gymrat
